releaseNotes: playbook/ — references are grouped by area of the business. All 95 files move out of the flat references/ directory into thirteen domain folders (research, product, experience, design, words, build, store, money, growth, data, trust, operations, process), each carrying a README.md index whose load-when triggers are lifted verbatim from SKILL.md rather than invented, so the routing agents already rely on survives the move. The catalogue that prompted this found provider-state-recipes.md sitting between product-moat.md and push-notification-lifecycle.md purely because of the alphabet — three unrelated parts of the business, adjacent by accident.

Two buckets the catalogue had conflated are now separate. machine/ holds only what a maintainer touches to keep the skill green: the eval harness, versioning, source freshness and its registry. Everything about how a launch is actually run — phases, durable state, coverage, artifact contracts, traceability, orchestration, change cascade — is method rather than machinery and lives in playbook/process/, where an agent loads it mid-launch and a maintainer rarely opens it. ARCHITECTURE.md gained the process/ domain, the narrower machine/ definition this exposed, and the README.md index convention.

SKILL.md collapses from eight routing tables and 72 rows to a single table of thirteen, one per domain, each pointing at that domain's index: 46,975 bytes down to 22,691, from five bytes of headroom under the 45KB ceiling to 23,389. The entrypoint's fullness was a symptom of detail living too high, not a budget problem — the restructuring paid for itself roughly twenty-three times over.

check-reference-size is rewritten to scan playbook/ and machine/ and to accept either index shape (a folder README.md, or a sibling <name>.md for a sub-split), recursing so nested splits like experience-cards/ keep their existing index. check-app-archetype no longer requires each pack's path in SKILL.md; it verifies the reachable chain SKILL.md to domain index to pack, since demanding leaf paths in the entrypoint is the accretion the collapse just undid. Seven further validators and eleven fixture modules were repointed, including the path.join call sites and synthetic fixture roots a path-shaped rewrite cannot see. npm run audit:ci green at 70 ok; fixture suite 716 pass.

The engineering domain is named engineering/, not build/, because domain folder names have to survive .gitignore. playbook/build/ was silently untracked through a whole CI run: the root .gitignore carries build/, which matches at any depth, so the moved files were tracked (git mv forces already-tracked files) while the new index was dropped by git add without a word, and the failure only surfaced as a missing-index error in CI. ARCHITECTURE.md gains a Naming traps section — check any future domain name with git check-ignore before committing to it, since dist, build, tmp, out, and target are all landmines.
